analysis.title: Red and Black Editorial Portfolio
analysis.notes: A dark portfolio composition uses a large portrait layered over oversized red typography, with restrained white text and red rules creating strong hierarchy. Dense project, skills, process, and contact sections are organized into a precise editorial grid with repeated numbering and outlined iconography.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a high-contrast editorial portfolio hero image: a young Southeast Asian male creative professional in a black jacket, shown in a confident three-quarter portrait against a nearly black studio background. Place oversized abstract condensed red letterforms behind him, partially obscured by the figure, with sharp directional lighting, deep shadows, subtle red rim light, and a refined fashion-magazine art direction. Use a vertical poster composition, restrained off-white micro-details, thin red graphic rules, and generous negative space. No logos, brand names, or readable text.
